title: Reconcile Once, Write Anytime: A Trust-Tiered Librarian and a Multi-Agent Writer for Drift-Free, Point-in-Time Research
abstract: arXiv:2608.12984v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-form research reports generated by large language models drift, contradict themselves, and lose provenance: the same metric appears with different values, and rumor is quoted as confidently as an audited filing. We present a two-tier agentic system that separates a maintained, point-in-time knowledge library from report writing. A deterministic "librarian" ingests timestamped sources into a trust-tiered ontology, layering evidence cards, an authoritative metric ledger, and a claim graph into an always-current source of truth, not per-query RAG over raw chunks. A portable multi-agent "writer" runtime then composes a contradiction-free, evidence-grounded report at any knowledge cutoff T, reading only evidence with as_of <= T (no look-ahead); red-team verdicts flow back into the librarian. translated_title: 一次协调，随时撰写：基于信任分层图书馆与多代理写手的无漂移、时点研究系统
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型生成的长篇研究报告存在漂移、自相矛盾和来源丢失的问题：同一指标出现不同数值，谣言与审计文件一样被自信引用。我们提出一个双层代理系统，将维护的时点知识库与报告撰写分离。一个确定性的“图书馆员”将带时间戳的来源摄入信任分层本体，构建证据卡片、权威指标台账和声明图，形成始终最新的真相源，而非基于原始块的每次查询RAG。一个便携式多代理“写手”运行时随后在任何知识截止时间T下撰写无矛盾、有证据支撑的报告，仅读取as_of <= T的证据（无前瞻）；红队裁决反馈回图书馆员。我们在自收集的公开语料上评估，包含6,130个来源，生成555,926张证据卡片（涵盖295个发行人和11个行业的SEC EDGAR文件）。
tldr: 本文提出一种双层代理系统，通过信任分层的确定性图书馆维护时点知识库，与多代理写手分离，实现无漂移、有来源的长篇研究报告生成。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a two-tier agentic system that separates a trust-tiered, deterministic knowledge library from a multi-agent writer, enabling drift-free, provenance-grounded long-form report generation.
